separator: The best (G) builds one idea per beat, ends the numbers with a huge stand-alone 4.1 and holds cleanly; the worst (C) puts small cards in an empty frame with tiny labels and black gaps, so it does not read at a glance. All five share a sliced-glitch closing line and count-up numbers.
